messages.text:
Hello Helium D. Support,
I’m trying to set up merged Litecoin/Dogecoin mining on my Hammer DC08 using Harlo OS and need help with the correct settings.
To test the pool connection, I set Pool 1 to Harlo’s default Litecoin address and Pool 2 to my own Litecoin address. Both pools work when I set the split to 100% and switch between them.
As soon as I enter my Dogecoin address in the password field for Pool 2, the miner will not start. I’m using the LiteSolo endpoint, us.litesolo.org:3333, and the password format DOGE= followed by my Dogecoin address. (LiteSolo<https://litesolo.org/>)
The same LTC/DOGE setup works correctly on the Hammer DC08 with Hammer Norn OS. How should I enter the Dogecoin address in Harlo OS? Does Harlo OS support the DOGE= password format for merged mining, or is there another setting or format I should use?
I also noticed the displayed hashrate can be incorrect after changing pool settings. It showed about 7.8 MH/s instead of the normal 400 MH/s. Restarting the miner corrected the hashrate.
Thank you,
Dean
Note to the team: Let me search for Harlo OS docs and merged mining support.
Searched the web · Harlo OS DC08 merged mining Dogecoin password
Searched the web · litesolo.org DOGE= password merged mining
Searched the web · harlolabs.com Harlo OS release notes
Handed to the team · I could not confirm whether Harlo OS accepts or parses a password containing "="

Hi Dean,

Thanks for testing each pool on its own first. Because both pools mine at a 100% split and only adding the Dogecoin password stops the miner, the pool and network side are fine. The problem is how Harlo OS handles that password.

I'll be honest: I couldn't confirm whether Harlo OS supports the DOGE= password format for merged mining, and I don't want to guess. Your setup works on Norn OS, so the format is right for LiteSolo. The open question is whether Harlo OS accepts or passes on a password containing "=". I've sent this to JD, who builds Harlo OS, with everything you've tested so far.

Until he replies, these checks will help him find the cause:

1. Check your Harlo OS version and compare it with the latest on https://harlolabs.com/ . If you're behind, update first and try again, since pool handling changes often.
2. Type the password again by hand as DOGE= followed by your address. Don't add spaces, quotes or a line break at the end. Pasting sometimes brings in a hidden space.
3. Put the same DOGE= password on Pool 1 and set it to 100%. If that fails too, the password itself is the trigger. If it works, the problem is in the dual-pool split.
4. When the miner won't start, note the log line or the message on the screen. That line will tell JD exactly where it stops.

On the hashrate: a reading of about 7.8 MH/s instead of about 400 MH/s that goes back to normal after a restart sounds like a display problem, not a slowdown in the miner. It would help JD to know whether the low number stayed for more than a few minutes after the pool change, or whether it might have recovered on its own. I've passed this on with the merged mining question.

JD picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and his answer will come to your email. For a faster answer, the Harlo OS channel on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf is very active. Tag @nullhashrate (that's JD) and include your firmware version and the log line.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support

Hi Hal,

I completed all of the suggested checks, including entering the DOGE= password manually and testing Pool 1 by itself at 100%. The miner still will not start whenever I enter a Dogecoin wallet address in the password field.

One other piece of feedback: no offense, but your email had almost no paragraph breaks or punctuation, which made it difficult to read. Please format future emails with clear paragraphs and punctuation. If the message was AI-generated, I suggest reviewing the output or changing the model or settings.

Please pass the test results along to JD. I’ll wait for his response.

Dean
Handed to the team · Test results are back on the merged mining issue I flagged yesterday. The fault

Hi Dean,

Thank you for running all of those checks. I've passed your results to JD.

Your Pool 1 test was the useful one. The miner fails even with a single pool at 100%. So the problem is the Dogecoin password itself, not the two-pool split. Your setup works on Norn OS, which points to how Harlo OS handles that field. JD builds Harlo OS, so he's the right person to answer this.

You're right about the formatting, and I'm sorry. Something went wrong with my last email: the paragraph breaks were lost and it was hard to read. I've laid this one out more carefully.

JD will reply in this thread, usually within one business day. If you'd like to follow along in the meantime, the Harlo OS channel on our Discord is at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. You can tag @nullhashrate (that's JD) there.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support
